question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"besides."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Besides"** means in addition to or apart from. (के अतिरिक्त, के साथ; भी)
 
• It is used to introduce an additional point or reason.
 
 
• **Example**: ***Besides**__ studying for her exams, she also works part-time at a cafundefined.*
 
 
 
• The sentence says that he could pursue such a claim if someone other than his employer or a coworker was accountable for his illness.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct sentence: 

Workers' compensation benefits in Pennsylvania should pay for your medical __bills__ and a portion of your lost wages. However, you cannot be __paid__ for pain and suffering or other non-financial damages that your illness or injury may __have caused__ you. A personal injury or wrongful death lawsuit, on the other hand, __allows__ compensation for the ill worker or surviving family members. If someone __besides__ your employer or a co-worker was to blame for your illness, you could pursue such a claim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "beyond"**, means on the other side of or farther away from. (की दूसरी ओर, के परे)
 
• **Option 2, "along",** means beside or parallel to. (के साथ-साथ, एक सिरे से दूसरे सिरे तक या की ओर)
 
• **Option 4, "beside"**, means next to or by the side of. 9के बग़ल में, के पास)
